purpose: Teach: 現われる/送れる/盛り上げる/おのずと/歩き回っ/さらい/か所/ソクラテス

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、夜空に、絶対、流れ星、絶対、現われる、絶対、瞬間、絶対、ぼく、絶対、見たいな
lines.en: Mom, I really, truly, absolutely want to see a shooting star appear in the night sky. I mean it.
lines.style: Breathless urgency. Each phrase tumbles over the last. Eyes wide. Leaning forward. The conviction of a six-year-old who has thought about this very carefully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんに、本気で、絶対、お手紙、絶対、送れる、絶対、よう、絶対、ママが、絶対、用意したわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I've already prepared the letter to send to Grandma for you. It's all ready.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring patience. Slight smile in the voice. Gentle, knowing — she's listened to this need before. Not dismissing it, honoring it by already having acted.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さんの誕生日、絶対、盛り上げる、絶対、ために、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お手伝いするよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to help you make Dad's birthday special. I'm going to help, I promise.
lines.style: Serious, almost solemn commitment. Slower than before. He's chosen this, thought it through. Pride and determination threading through the words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、努力していれば、絶対、おのずと、絶対、結果は、絶対、ついてくるわよ
lines.en: Sho, when you really try hard, good things naturally follow. That's how it works.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom. Spoken as if she's sharing something she's learned herself. Not lecturing — offering. Steady, almost gentle. The words carry their own weight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、公園を、絶対、歩き回って、絶対、お花、絶対、たくさん、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I walked all around the park today and saw so many flowers. So many.
lines.style: Animated delight. The rush of having witnessed something wonderful. Quick pace, genuine excitement. Slightly breathless. Eyes probably bright with the memory of it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、勉強の、絶対、おさらい、絶対、毎日、絶対、しっかりね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you review your lessons every single day, alright? Keep at it.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. A mother's steady expectation. Not harsh — grounded, practical. A pause before 'every day' to emphasize the routine matters. Warm underneath the directive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの好きな本屋さん、絶対、近所に、絶対、二か所、絶対、あるんだ
lines.en: Mom, did you know there are two bookstores near us, and I love both of them?
lines.style: Eager to share a discovery. Proud of knowing something true about his world. Slightly faster pace. The pleasure of being taken seriously as someone who notices things.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、学生時代、絶対、ソクラテス、絶対、の研究、絶対、していたって、翔くん
lines.en: Your father used to study Socrates when he was your age, Sho. Did you know that?
lines.style: Reflective, almost wistful. A gentle thread between past and present. She's offering him something — a connection, a lineage. Slight warmth at the end. Closing the conversation with care.
